# Ratchet & Clank (2002)

Insomniac Games' first Ratchet & Clank, released on the PlayStation 2 in 2002. OpenRAC builds
its native PC port from two decomps: our own, rac1-decomp, which holds the PAL and Japanese
releases, and the third-party NTSC decomp of the North American release.

PAL v1.00 and v2.00 boot the same file name; the launcher tells them apart by the disc's version.
How the versions relate, and how NTSC-U is also built from rac1-decomp: [VERSIONS.md](VERSIONS.md).

## In this folder

| | |
|---|---|
| [game.json](game.json) | the discs, their checksums, and which decomp each version is built from, at which commit |
| [decomp/](decomp/README.md) | [rac1-decomp](https://github.com/OpenRAC/rac1-decomp), our decomp (git submodule): PAL v2.00, PAL v1.00 and NTSC-J |
| [decomp-patches/](decomp-patches/README.md) | OpenRAC-only changes to `decomp/`, each with its reason |
| [ntsc-decomp/](ntsc-decomp/README.md) | the third-party NTSC decomp, [Lombyte](https://github.com/lombyte-project/Lombyte) (git submodule): NTSC-U. Kept apart from ours |
| [ntsc-decomp-patches/](ntsc-decomp-patches/README.md) | OpenRAC-only changes to `ntsc-decomp/`, each with its reason |
| [VERSIONS.md](VERSIONS.md) | how the versions relate |

The port's code for each version is in `port/game/rac1-<version>/` (the table above), with what
the versions share in [port/game/rac1/](../../port/game/rac1/README.md).

How to check these out, change a patch or move a pin: [docs/SOURCES.md](../../docs/SOURCES.md).
